newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Turk Cypriots give Greek Cypriot jail term.
newsitem.headline: Turk Cypriots give Greek Cypriot jail term.

text.p: A Turkish Cypriot military court on Monday sentenced a Greek Cypriot to 15 days in jail for illegal entry into Turkish-controlled northern Cyprus and trespassing in a military area, witnesses said.

Savvas Siderenou, aged 22, was arrested nine days ago after he crossed the "green line" which divides the Greek and Turkish communities on the island near the village of Achna close to a British military base.
He was earlier remanded in custody after a brief hearing shortly after his arrest. His sentence was to begin on Monday, witnesses said.
Cyprus has been divided since Turkey invaded the island in 1974 in response to a Greek Cypriot coup in Nicosia backed by the military ruling Greece at the time.

The international community, with the exception of Turkey, recognises the Greek Cypriot administration in the south as the only government on the island. The Turkish Cypriot administration in the north is recognised only by Turkey.
